_comment: Known-and-accepted advisories. CI fails on anything NOT listed here, so this file is the repo's dependency-debt ledger, not an ignore-list to grow casually. Every entry is an advisory id and the reason it is accepted. The gate fails on an entry with no reason, and on an entry whose advisory is gone, until it is pruned (#821): a stale entry is still an exemption for that id if a downgrade brings the advisory back. Started at 91 entries (#342); two remain, neither with a fixed version to move to. Regenerate with: python scripts/audit_gate.py --pip-audit <json> --npm-audit <json> --baseline security-baseline.json --write-baseline, which keeps the reasons already written and leaves a new entry's reason empty for a person to fill in.

npm.GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm: braces 3.0.3 (no patched version, all <=3.0.3 affected); build-time only via @tailwindcss/cli > @parcel/watcher > micromatch, globs are repo-controlled, not user input. Prune when braces ships a fix.
npm.GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c: sprintf-js 1.0.3 (no patched version, all <=1.1.3 affected; a format string with a huge precision exhausts memory); test-time only via jest > babel-plugin-istanbul > @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config > js-yaml 3 > argparse 1, which formats its own fixed help text with it, never input. Prune when sprintf-js ships a fix or jest's coverage chain drops js-yaml 3.
